tools.name: search_companies
tools.title: Search Cyprus companies
tools.description: Search the public Cyprus company registry by company name fragment or registration number (e.g. 'HE 252407', 'C 4404'). Returns matching companies with registration number, status, district and a profile URL.

query.description: Company name fragment or registration number.

page.description: Result page, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.title: Get Cyprus company profile
tools.description: Return the full public registry profile for one Cyprus company: registration number, type, status, registration date, company age, address in Greek and transliterated Latin script, and listed officials. Accepts a registration number ('HE 252407', 'C 4404'), a profile slug, or an exact-ish company name.

identifier.description: Registration number, profile slug, or company name to resolve.

tools.name: list_products
tools.title: List orderable reports and certificates
tools.description: List the Cyprus company reports, certificates and packs that can be ordered on Companies House Cyprus, with prices in EUR, delivery times and order URLs.

category.description: Optional filter: certificate, report or pack.
